description: Shared PlaceProto definitions: the complete event view and its version metadata.

eventView.description: A complete PlaceProto event: the sidecar's URI, the community event it references, that event's current record value and the sidecar's location.

uri.description: AT-URI of the PlaceProto event sidecar.

eventUri.description: AT-URI of the community event the sidecar references.

event.description: The complete current community.lexicon.calendar.event record value, including its $type.

version.description: Record versions, present when the view is read for editing.

eventVersion.description: Versions of the two records that make up a PlaceProto event.

eventCid.description: CID of the community event record.

sidecarCid.description: CID of the PlaceProto event sidecar record.
